A Little Place for Big Cravings

Hungry's Bucket Cafe is a pure vegetarian spot in Old Katra, Prayagraj. Come for a hot or cold coffee, stay for the snacks, and try the vegetarian Chinese dishes when the craving gets bigger.

  • Pure VegetarianEvery item is vegetarian.
  • Coffee & SnacksEasy bites with your cup.
  • Chinese CuisineNoodles, rice and more.
